nom: Perricone MD High Potency Hyaluronic Intensive Hydrating Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including several with dry winter or naturally dry skin, are the most consistent group and say the serum plumps and hydrates without leaving skin greasy, though one reviewer with dry skin says it pills when layered with her other moisturizing products.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including several with rosacea, broadly report no irritation, stinging, or breakouts; the one dissent says it was not as intensively hydrating for her sensitive skin as she had hoped.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin say the serum helps their dry patches without making their oily areas worse, calling it well balanced across both.
segments.oily: The reviewers who mention oily skin or oily zones say the serum absorbs without a greasy residue and seemed to calm an oily forehead or oily patches rather than worsen them.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s and 50s, several explicitly describing their skin as aging, report smoother, more hydrated, plumper skin and, in some cases, softened fine lines with regular use.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers focused on fine lines and wrinkles report a visible plumping effect that softens crow's feet and fine lines within two to several weeks of use; one reviewer, however, says the serum worked well for hydration but made no noticeable difference to her wrinkles.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers report strong, fast-absorbing hydration that leaves skin plump and soft, several calling it the most hydrating serum they have tried; the dissent is a minority who found it not intensely hydrating enough, felt it turned heavy or greasy in warm weather, or noticed it pilling when layered with other moisturizing products.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers report reduced redness, including one who paired it with tretinoin and one targeting sun-related redness around her nose; one reviewer, by contrast, broke out in red, itchy splotches she suspects were a reaction to the formula.
concerns.barrier: The few reviewers who mention their skin barrier credit the serum with calming it after seasonal dryness and flaking, and with providing relief when used after acids or retinol.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts and several say breakouts became less frequent while using the serum; the dissent includes a reviewer who broke out after applying it to fully dry rather than damp skin, and another who developed red, itchy irritation she attributes to the formula.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin or oily zones say the serum absorbs without leaving a greasy residue and, in a couple of cases, seemed to calm an oily forehead without over-drying it; one reviewer who normally uses only a light moisturizer found it made her skin greasy and gave it a hard pass.

aspects.libelle: Pump dispenser feels flimsy or hard to use
Layers well under makeup without pilling

extraits.titre: Causes pilling with other moisturizing products
extraits.texte: The consistency is quite thick for a serum. It is almost like a serum and a light moisturizer in one. However, I have dry skin so I need to use a moisturizer along with it. The issue with that is that it can pill when used with other serums and moisturizers.

extraits.titre: Seems like it would be amazing, but my skin was not a fan
extraits.texte: I was kindly gifted the Perricone MD High Potency Hyaluronic Intensive Hydrating Serum in exchange for an honest review. This serum is designed with 4 forms and 2 natural building blocks of hyaluronic acid to instantly replenish with essential moisture for visibly smoother, firmer and plumper skin. This fast-absorbing formula helps strengthen skin's moisture barrier, increase the feel of skin cushion and reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles for a healthy, youthful-looking appearance. Leaves skin looking and feeling soft, supple and rejuvenated. It addresses dehydration, dryness, dullness, fine lines and wrinkles. Clinical results (according to their website) show a marked difference in skin hydration, skin barrier function, skin feel and texture, dullness, fine lines and wrinkles. Count me innnn!!! I loved how it felt on my skin and it did seem like my skin looked and felt more hydrated. It absorbed quickly and felt lightweight. Unfortunately, my skin broke out in red splotches and became super itchy. I also had a bit of a reaction to the scent despite it being very subtle and almost non-existent. Super disappointed because I would have loved to use it more!

extraits.titre: A nice feeling product but not as hydrating as I was hoping
extraits.texte: My skin gets so dry in the winter so I was so excited to try this product! It has great ingredients and the packaging feels very luxe in an understated way. I didn't get any irritation from it which was promising because I have very sensitive skin. There is a scent but it is light and didn't bother me at all. The actual product seems lightweight which I guess makes sense because to me, it wasn't as intensively hydrating as I was hoping it would be. It felt great but I would use it more in the summer months when my skin isn't so dry and in need of serious hydration.

I love this!!! It feels so hydrating when you apply and I feel like after a month of use I have more of a glow. It rubs in nicely and for a minute seems a bit greasy but it soaks in wonderfully. I have combo skin and I feel like it works well, helping the dry spots but not making the oily spots worse! I love the pump dispenser, one pump goes a long way!

extraits.titre: I love how my skin feels after using this product
extraits.texte: I absolutely love this Perricone MD hyaluronic hydrating serum. It comes in a glass bottle with a pump for easy dispensing. I've been using it daily for several weeks and the results feel amazing. For reference I'm 43 yrs old with lots of freckles. I have been out in the sun a lot so my freckles are getting darker. My skin feels so smooth. I mist my face with a spray bottle of water because it says to apply to damp skin. Then it rubs in smooth. It doesn't feel sticky and dries very quickly. My skin feels so hydrated. I've always had oily skin and ai feel like this has also helped with my oily forehead. It doesn't have any perfumes or scent. I've had zero irritation or break outs. I will continue to purchase this after my bottle runs out. I love how my face and neck feel after using this product.

This is the third Perricone product I've tried and they all are winners! This hydrating serum is fantastic. The smell is subtle, but really nice. The consistency is perfect for gliding all over your face and neck easily. As for the hydration? It is off the charts! I have very dry skin that gets tight and uncomfortable after washing and this was the remedy I needed! It is nourishing, calming, and super duper hydrating! 10/10 stars ⭐️

It has a neutral scent and the overall product design is great. I love that the pump has to be installed; that helps prevent issues of the pump being broken in transit. The product itself seems to be good for sensitive skin, even for a girl like me with rosacea. I haven't had any breakouts while using it. It absorbs well.
